provenancePolicy.facts: 200 readings grounded in linked official/open Japanese sources, all using 2026 source material in this release. The v7 expansion adds 100 graded readings from 20 verified source families (five support levels per family).
provenancePolicy.learnerText: Learner adaptations are clearly identified. v7 source-family readings add level-specific framing and reuse only Sakura source-grounded paragraphs; no adapted text is presented as verbatim government prose.
provenancePolicy.attribution: Every record stores source title, publisher, URL, date, terms/license, and edit notice.
provenancePolicy.assets: No source logos, photos, charts, videos, or separately credited third-party assets are included.
provenancePolicy.studyLevel: N5–N1 is Sakura study-support grading, not an official JLPT grade of the source.

sourceYearPolicy: 2026 first; if a category lacks suitable legally reusable 2026 material, use 2025, then 2024, then the newest verified legally reusable source available. Always display the actual source year.
packPolicy: Each JLPT level is split into four small lazy-loaded packs (10 readings each) so individual JSON payloads remain comfortably below ~100 KB.
